name: Special City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
TUESDAY, DECEMBER 8, 2020 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
4.
AGENDA ITEMS
4A.
Adoption of Resolution 2020-97 reciting the facts of the General Municipal Election held on November 3, 2020, and declaring the results as provided by law. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2020-97 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Reciting the Facts of the General Municipal Election Held on November 3, 2020, Declaring the Results and Such Other Matters as Provided by Law.”
2020-12-08 Special Meeting Item 04A Certification of Election
4B.
City Clerk to Administer Oaths of Office to Mayor Catherine Blakespear, Council Member District 1 Tony Kranz and Council Member District 2 Kellie Hinze.
4C.
Discussion and selection of the Deputy Mayor.
Council to select one of its members as Deputy Mayor.
2020-12-08 Special Meeting Item 04C Selection of Deputy Mayor
4D.
Discussion and possible appointments of Encinitas City Council Members to Regional Boards and Committees, and consideration and possible action regarding existing Ad-Hoc Subcommittee and appointments and Council Liaisons. Contact Person: Executive Assistant Clisby
1) Council to make recommendations and approve final appointments of Representative and Alternate to the North County Transit District (NCTD) 2021 Board of Directors; 2) Council to make recommendations and approve final appointments of Representative, Alternate, and Second Alternate to the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) 2021 Board of Directors; 3) Mayor to make recommendations and Council to approve all other 2021 regional board and committee appointments; and 4) Council to consider and possibly take action regarding appointments to standing subcommittees, active ad-hoc subcommittee appointments, and Council liaisons.
2020-12-08 Special Meeting Item 04D Regional Committee and Board Appointments
4E.
Consideration of Proposed Changes to the 2021 Calendar Year City Council Meeting Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the proposed changes to the 2021 calendar year City Council Meeting Schedule and adopt City Council Resolution 2020-106 approving the 2021 meeting schedule.
2020-12-08 Special Meeting Item 04E 2021 Council Meeting Schedule
5.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON DECEMBER 9, 2020
4C.
Discussion and selection of the Deputy Mayor.
Council to select one of its members as Deputy Mayor.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
